name: The Platinum Discs
summary: A miniature Discs of Norgannon is to be taken to one of the sages in Thunder Bluff. You are carrying it there for a sage.

sections.title: A Sage in Thunder Bluff
sections.body: One of the sages in Thunder Bluff is to receive the miniature Discs of Norgannon from you.

faq.q: What do I take to Thunder Bluff?
faq.answer: You take a miniature version of the Discs of Norgannon to one of Thunder Bluff's sages.
One of the sages in Thunder Bluff receives the miniature Discs of Norgannon.

faq.q: Where do I bring the Discs of Norgannon?
faq.answer: Bring the miniature Discs of Norgannon to one of the sages in Thunder Bluff.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Platinum Discs
